bullets_en: Osmania Medical College junior doctors to start strike from Oct 12.
New Deputy Election Commissioner appointed in ECI amid concerns over work hierarchy.
Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro beats polls in presidential vote, faces Lula in runoff.
PM Modi arrives in Chennai to launch Rs 13,000 crore projects.
From peaceful protests to free movement: 9 directions SC issued amid CJP stir in Delhi.
bullets_ur: Osmania Medical College ke junior doctors Oct 12 se hartal shuru karein ge.
Work hierarchy par tahaffuzat ke darmiyan ECI mein naye Deputy Election Commissioner taainat.
Brazil ke Flavio Bolsonaro ne sadarti vote mein polls ko maat di, runoff mein Lula ka samna karein ge.
PM Modi 13,000 crore rupay ke projects ka aaghaz karne Chennai pohnch gaye.
Pur-aman ehtijaj se aazad naql-o-harkat tak: Delhi mein CJP ehtijaj par SC ne 9 hidayaat jari keen.
